exposure: Obesity status among PCOS women with multiple gestations
cohort: 14,882 women with PCOS who delivered between 2004 and 2014
finding: Among women with PCOS, multiple gestation significantly increased the risk of various pregnancy complications, including pre-eclampsia, gestational diabetes, preterm delivery, and cesarean section.
mod_finding: Multiple gestation in women with PCOS increased the risk of Cesarean section.
